
**WGCNA pipeline**




```{r}
## DATA PROCESSING

# read in data
counts_matrix <- read.csv("~/Desktop/OVOL1_proj/hit-counts/raw_counts.csv")

#renaming sample to maintain consistencies
counts_matrix <- counts_matrix %>% rename(
  K5.rTA.1 = K5.1,
  K5.rTA.2 = K5.2,
  K5.rTA.3 = K5.3,
  K5.OVOL1.1 = K5Ovol1.1,
  K5.OVOL1.2 = K5Ovol1.2,
  K5.OVOL1.3 = K5Ovol1.3,
)

datExpr <- readRDS("~/Desktop/OVOL1_proj/datExpr.rds")

# change row names in for consistencies
rownames(datExpr) <- c("K5.rtTA.3", "K5.rtTA.2", "K5.rtTA.1",
                       "K5.OVOL1.3", "K5.OVOL1.2", "K5.OVOL1.1",
                       "WT.3", "WT.2", "WT.1")
```


```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# Load Libraries & Set Options
# ==============================================================================

library(WGCNA)
library(DESeq2)
library(tidyverse)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Mm.eg.db) # Mouse annotation library
library(enrichplot)
library(igraph)
library(tidygraph)
library(ggraph)
library(ggplot2)

# WGCNA specific settings
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
enableWGCNAThreads() # Enable multi-threading for faster execution

```


```{r}

# ==============================================================================
# Quality Control & Sample Outlier Detection
# ==============================================================================
gsg <- goodSamplesGenes(datExpr, verbose = 3)
if (!gsg$allOK) {
  datExpr <- datExpr[gsg$goodSamples, gsg$goodGenes]
}

# Cluster samples to detect outliers
sampleTree <- hclust(dist(datExpr), method = "average")
plot(sampleTree, main = "Sample clustering to detect outliers", 
     sub = "", xlab = "", cex.lab = 1.5, cex.axis = 1.5, cex.main = 2)
```
```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# Select Soft-Thresholding Power 
# ==============================================================================
# For unsigned/signed networks with small sample size (n < 20), 
# powers higher than default might be necessary to achieve scale-free topology.
powers <- c(c(1:10), seq(from = 12, to = 20, by = 2))
sft <- pickSoftThreshold(datExpr, powerVector = powers, verbose = 5, networkType = "signed")

# Plot the scale-free topology fit index
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
plot(sft$fitIndices[, 1], -sign(sft$fitIndices[, 3]) * sft$fitIndices[, 2],
     xlab = "Soft Threshold (power)", ylab = "Scale Free Topology Model Fit, signed R^2",
     type = "n", main = "Scale independence")
text(sft$fitIndices[, 1], -sign(sft$fitIndices[, 3]) * sft$fitIndices[, 2],
     labels = powers, cex = 0.9, col = "red")
abline(h = 0.80, col = "red") # Target R^2 threshold


# Choose power: Pick the lowest power where R^2 reaches ~0.80 (or maximum plateau)
softPower <- sft$powerEstimate 
if(is.na(softPower)) softPower <- 12 # Fallback recommendation for signed networks n < 20
```
```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# Construct Co-expression Network & Identify Modules
# ==============================================================================
net <- blockwiseModules(
  datExpr,
  power = softPower,
  networkType = "signed",           # "signed" or "signed hybrid" recommended for TF expression
  TOMType = "signed",
  minModuleSize = 30,               # Minimum size for gene modules
  reassignThreshold = 0,
  mergeCutHeight = 0.25,            # Merge modules with correlation >= 0.75
  numericLabels = TRUE,
  pamRespectsDendro = FALSE,
  saveTOMs = FALSE,
  verbose = 3
)

# Convert numeric labels to color labels
moduleColors <- labels2colors(net$colors)

# Plot Dendrogram with Module Colors
plotDendroAndColors(net$dendrograms[[1]], moduleColors[net$blockGenes[[1]]],
                    "Module colors",
                    dendroLabels = FALSE, hang = 0.03,
                    addGuide = TRUE, guideHang = 0.05,
                    main = "Cluster Dendrogram and Module Colors")
# save results

saveRDS(net, file = "~/Desktop/OVOL1_proj/net_wgcna_output.rds")
```


```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# Identify the Ovol1 Module and Core Hub Genes
# ==============================================================================
# Locate Ovol1 module color
# Note: Ensure gene name matches your matrix format (e.g., "Ovol1" or "OVOL1")
target_gene <- "Ovol1" 

if (target_gene %in% colnames(datExpr)) {
  ovol1_module <- moduleColors[which(colnames(datExpr) == target_gene)]
  cat("Ovol1 is located in module:", ovol1_module, "\n")
  
  # Extract all genes in the Ovol1 module
  module_genes <- colnames(datExpr)[moduleColors == ovol1_module]
  
  # Calculate Module Membership (MM) / kME
  # Calculates correlation between individual gene expression profiles and Module Eigengene (ME)
  MEs <- net$MEs
  colnames(MEs) <- paste0("ME", labels2colors(as.numeric(gsub("ME", "", colnames(MEs)))))
  
  geneModuleMembership <- as.data.frame(cor(datExpr, MEs, use = "p"))
  MMPvalue <- as.data.frame(corPvalueStudent(as.matrix(geneModuleMembership), nrow(datExpr)))
  
  # Extract MM for Ovol1 module
  target_col <- paste0("ME", ovol1_module)
  ovol1_module_df <- data.frame(
    Gene = module_genes,
    ModuleMembership = geneModuleMembership[module_genes, target_col],
    Pvalue = MMPvalue[module_genes, target_col]
  ) %>% 
    arrange(desc(ModuleMembership))
  
  # Output top hub genes co-expressed with Ovol1
  head(ovol1_module_df, 20)
  
} else {
  warning("Ovol1 was not found in the filtered dataset. Consider relaxing initial variance filters.")
}

# ==============================================================================
# Export Module Genes for Downstream Enrichment (ClusterProfiler)
# ==============================================================================
# Save genes in Ovol1 module to CSV
write.csv(ovol1_module_df, file = "~/Desktop/OVOL1_proj/Ovol1_Coexpression_Module_Genes.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```


Pathway enrichment - ClusterProfiler
```{r}
# Filter for core hub genes (e.g., top Module Membership / kME > 0.7 or top 100-200 genes)
hub_genes <- ovol1_module_df %>%
  filter(ModuleMembership >= 0.95 & Pvalue < 0.005) %>% 
  pull(Gene)

cat("Number of hub genes for enrichment:", length(hub_genes), "\n")

# Convert gene symbols to Entrez IDs
gene_ids <- bitr(
  hub_genes, 
  fromType = "SYMBOL", 
  toType   = "ENTREZID", 
  OrgDb    = org.Mm.eg.db
)

# Vector of Entrez IDs
entrez_vec <- gene_ids$ENTREZID

# Run GO Enrichment for Biological Processes (BP)
ego_bp <- enrichGO(
  gene          = entrez_vec,
  OrgDb         = org.Mm.eg.db,
  ont           = "BP",                # "BP" for Biological Process
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",                # Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment
  pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
  qvalueCutoff  = 0.10,
  readable      = TRUE                 # Converts Entrez IDs back to Gene Symbols in results
)

# View top enriched terms
head(ego_bp)

# Save GO results to CSV
write.csv(as.data.frame(ego_bp), "Ovol1_Module_GO_BP_Enrichment.csv", row.names = FALSE)


# Run KEGG Enrichment (mmu = Mus musculus)
kegg_res <- enrichKEGG(
  gene         = entrez_vec,
  organism     = "mmu",
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05
)

# Convert Entrez IDs back to symbols in the KEGG object for readability
kegg_res <- setReadable(kegg_res, OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db, keyType = "ENTREZID")

# View top KEGG pathways
head(kegg_res)

# Save KEGG results to CSV
write.csv(as.data.frame(kegg_res), "Ovol1_Module_KEGG_Enrichment.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
